name: Facet
text:
Adopt a **system-wide dark theme by default** with a **persistent, non-modal light mode toggle** visible in the top-right corner.

Dark themes reduce eye strain in low-light conditions and align with user expectations from competitive dashboards like Manus and Graphify. The toggle ensures accessibility without disrupting the interface’s liveliness or clarity. Trade-off: some users may prefer light mode in bright environments, but the default dark theme prioritizes consistency and visual impact.

name: Pane
text: A system-wide dark theme with a toggle still forces glare-sensitive users to endure the default glare of the dark theme before toggling—glare sensitivity isn’t just about brightness, it’s about contrast. Instead, default to **light mode** with a persistent dark mode toggle, matching the Manus and Graphify dashboards’ flexibility without penalizing users who need it most. Settle this by testing glare-sensitive users in both modes—if dark mode’s contrast still strains them, the default must flip.
